The season began on 7 January 2017 and ended on 25 November 2017.{{cite web | url=http://www.vnleague.com/vpf/hoat-dong/7760-Ngay-8-1-2017-giai-bong-da-VDQG-chinh-thuc-khoi-tranh.html | title=Ngày 8/1/2017, giải bóng đá VĐQG chính thức khởi tranh | access-date=24 April 2017 | archive-date=13 May 2017 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170513000818/http://www.vnleague.com/vpf/hoat-dong/7760-Ngay-8-1-2017-giai-bong-da-VDQG-chinh-thuc-khoi-tranh.html | last=Nguyen |first=Duc Manh | url-status=dead}} The season was twice interrupted due to the Vietnam Football Federation's decision to stop the league for 4 weeks due to the [[2017 FIFA U-20 World Cup]], and then again for 7 weeks for the [[Football at the 2017 Southeast Asian Games – Men's tournament|29th SEA Games]]. ==Changes from the previous season== ===Team changes=== The following teams have changed division since the 2016 season. {{col-begin}} ====To V.League 1==== '''Promoted from [[2016 V.League 2|V.League 2]]''' * [[Ho Chi Minh City FC]] ====From V.League 1==== '''Relegated to [[2017 V.League 2|V.League 2]]''' * [[Dong Thap FC]] {{col-end}} ===Rule changes=== There is no longer a play-off match this season, so there is only one direct relegation spot. ===Names changes=== In January 2017, [[Hanoi FC|Hanoi T&T]] were renamed Hanoi FC and [[Quang Nam FC|QNK Quang Nam]] were renamed Quang Nam FC. ===Stadium changes=== [[SHB Danang FC|SHB Danang]] moved into [[Hòa Xuân Stadium|Hoa Xuan Stadium]] from [[Chi Lăng Stadium|Chi Lang Stadium]]. ==Teams==
